title_en: Wisdom in Calling People to Islam [2]
body_ar:
إن الأصل في الدعوة إلى الله تعالى أن تكون بالحكمة والموعظة الحسنة، والجدال بالتي هي أحسن، وهذا الأسلوب مطلوب في حق الكافرين فضلاً عن عصاة المؤمنين، ولا يعارض هذا قتال المشركين، أو إقامة الحدود على الفاسقين، فكل له موطنه. ومن الحكمة في الدعوة إلى الله تعالى التطبيق العملي لكل أمور الدين؛ إذ به تكتمل الدائرة، ويسد الفراغ بين العلم والعمل.
كيفية دعوة غير المسلمين بالحكمة:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعثه ربه رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه، ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فقد سبق أن تحدثنا عن مفهوم الدعوة إلى الله خصائصها ومميزاتها وأسسها وضوابطها وسنتحدث -بحول الله- عن بعض وسائل الدعوة إلى الله، كما في قوله تعالى في سورة النحل: ادْعُ إِلَى سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ وَجَادِلْهُمْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ [النحل:125] ، فلنأخذ من هذه الآية نبراساً نهتدي به إلى ما نقول، والله الموفق في القول والعمل...
body_en:
*[Site synopsis]* The default in calling people to God, exalted is He, is that it be done with wisdom and fair exhortation, and by disputing in the way that is best. This manner is required in dealing with those who reject faith, let alone with believers who disobey. This is not in conflict with fighting those who associate partners with God, nor with carrying out the prescribed penalties upon the transgressors: each has its own place. And part of wisdom in calling people to God, exalted is He, is the practical application of every matter of the religion, for by it the circle is completed and the gap between knowledge and action is closed.

## How to call non-Muslims with wisdom

In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Mercy-Giving. Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds. I ask God's blessing and peace upon the one whom his Lord sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his Companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the Day of Judgement. To proceed: we have already spoken about the concept of calling people to God, its characteristics, its distinguishing features, its foundations and its governing limits. We shall now speak — by God's power — about some of the means of calling people to God, as in His words, exalted is He, in Sūrat al-Naḥl: {Call to the way of your Lord with wisdom and fair exhortation, and dispute with them in the way that is best. Your Lord is He who knows best who has strayed from His way, and He knows best those who are guided} (Sūrat al-Naḥl 16:125). Let us take from this verse a lamp by which to be guided to what we say; and God is the one who grants success in word and in deed …

flags.note: A sentence about fighting and about prescribed penalties, written in English and read out of context, carries reputational and legal weight in some jurisdictions; style guide section 12 applies. It is translated faithfully, neither softened nor strengthened. Two things must stay visible to a reader. First, it falls entirely inside the site's synopsis: the transcribed portion of the lesson contains not one word of it, so it must not be quoted as the Sheikh's. Second, its actual claim is a narrow one about the scope of two rules — that the command to call with wisdom does not repeal them — and not an exhortation to either. The decision whether and how to publish belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.

flags.note: 'الأصل' in a legal-theory register is the presumptive position that holds unless displaced — which is exactly the sense the sentence needs, since the next clause is about what does not displace it. 'Default' carries that; 'basis' and 'origin' would not.

translator_notes: One of a run of six records, IDs 701-706, in the written-da'wah section, all uploaded on 9 May 2011 within about twenty minutes of one another, all built to the same template and all excerpts. Each carries a site-written synopsis, then a section heading, then the opening formula and the first lines of a lesson, and then breaks off on an ellipsis; the full text sits behind a .doc download in the /medias/doc/c-c-* series. The uniform timestamps are a bulk upload and say nothing about when the lesson was delivered.

The record contains two distinct voices and the English keeps them apart. The opening paragraph is a synopsis written by the site, about the lesson and in the third person; everything from the section heading onward is the Sheikh's own words as transcribed. Nothing in the synopsis may be quoted as his.

The source's final line, 'تحميل المادة' ('download the material'), is the label of a download link in the page furniture, not part of the text. It is recorded as source_download_link and omitted from body_ar and body_en.
Qur'anic renderings here are interpretive and are not a substitute for the Arabic.
The SEF alias of this record carries no timestamp, so no upload time can be read from it; records 701 and 704 in the same bulk upload are stamped 9 May 2011 at 12:42 and 12:56, which brackets it.
'إقامة الحدود' is rendered 'carrying out the prescribed penalties'. 'حدود' here is the technical term for the fixed scriptural penalties, not limits in general.
No ruling term from the five-rulings table appears anywhere in the record.
